title: Tasteful run journal entry v1
description: One JSON object per non-blank line of .tasteful/journal/run.jsonl. Blank/whitespace-only lines are skipped; every non-blank line must parse to a non-null non-array object with integer seq >= 1. seq is contiguous from 1 and prev_hash chains from GENESIS; payload_hash is sha256(canonical payload). A missing or blank journal is healthy only while the project has no decisions/gates/events; once state exists it is E_JOURNAL_CORRUPT (the chain never restarts at seq 1). Unknown extra entry fields are tolerated on read for forward compatibility and are not hashed. The leaf must be a regular file (E_JOURNAL_LEAF). State-changing paths verify the journal before consuming approvals or mutating state.
